title: The Smiling Room
author: Ansel Marchetti
blurb: Vesper Montrose, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, doesn't believe, has never believed, will not begin believing now. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
